binding_rule: A future frozen control must bind this authority, candidate and replay to the same exact completed Git revision and their fixed paths, and bind the case to case_input_revision/case_path. Compare cached buffers to that revision and hash once when consumed. Paths in this document are metadata to check against source-defined paths, never paths to follow.
source_bound_rule: The reviewed producer source writes the new candidate from construct(), calls the separately authored exact verifier on that same in-memory candidate and case, requires strict_pass before publishing PASS and exact upper, and preserves failure otherwise. The completed output and resource receipts plus independent interpretation review qualify this transfer. No arbitrary cached artifact is admitted.
reuse_scope: Use certified loads/upper and selected routes as a paid incumbent/start. Do not replay the already passed upper merely for reuse. New returned candidates still require their own independent physical admission. No support/hull/optimality certificate transfers.
